93:2: And oath be upon the night, when it covers.
93:3: Your Rabb did not abandon you and did not detest you.
93:4: And surely the Hereafter is better for you than the first.
93:5: And surely your Rabb will give you, and you will be pleased.
93:6: Did He not find and shelter you as an orphan
93:7: He found you astray and guided.
93:8: And He found you in need, thus He made you rich.
93:10: And do not scold the one who asks.
93:11: And as for, tell with the blessing of your Rabb.
